texts.preamble: Faisal V.B vs District Police Chief on 29 March, 2019 Author: P.R.Ramachandra Menon Bench: P.R.Ramachandra Menon In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr.Justice P.R.Ramachandra Menon & The Honourable Mr.Justice N.Anil Kumar Friday ,The 29Th Day Of March, 2019 / 8Th Chaithra, 1941 WP(C).No. 4634 of 2019 Petitioner: Faisal V.B Aged 35 Years S/O. Basheer, Valiyakath House, Vadanappalli Beach P.O, Thrissur-680614. By Adv. Sri.A.Rajasimhan Respondents: 1 District Police Chief Thrissur Rural, Thrissur-680001. 2 Station House Officer, Vadanappalli Police Station, Thrissur-680614. Addlr3 Addl. Shri. Ramdas Aged 35 Years, S/O.Gopi, Madathil House, Naduvilkara Vadanapilly, Thrissur - 680 614. Addl.R.3 Is Impleaded As Per Order On I.A.No.1/2019 Dated 29.3.2019. By Advs. Addl.R3 By Sri.Rajit Other Present: Faisal V.B vs District Police Chief on 29 March, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185554435/ 1 R1 To R3 By Sr.P.P.Thajudeen, Sr.Gp This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On 29.03.2019, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: Wp(C) No.4634 Of 2019 :-2-: Wp(C).No. 4634 Of 2019 J U D G M E N T
texts.facts: Petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking the following relief:- "1. Issue a writ of mandamus, or any other writ, order or direction, directing the respondents 1 and 2 to give adequate and effective police protection for the functioning of the petitioner's hotel Rice Bowl Food Court at Vadanappally." 2. The petitioner along with his five friends have been running a hotel under the name and style 'Rice Bowl Food Court' at Vadanappally in Thrissur District by virtue of Ext.P1 partnership deed. The Vadanappally Grama Panchayat issued Ext.P2 D&O licence for the above hotel in the name of the petitioner. According to the petitioner, on 3.1.2019, Sabarimala Karma Samithi declared a statewide Harthal and its sympathizers made an attempt to forcefully close down the hotel. According to the petitioner, the activists and sympathisers of the Harthal had attacked the hotel on that day in which case and counter case were registered against the Harthal activists and the hotel staff as Crime Nos.8/2019 and 9/2019 respectively of Vadanappally Police Station. The WP(C) NO.4634 OF 2019 :-3-: complaint of the petitioner is that consequent to the harthal, the Police has instructed the petitioner to close down the business saying that there is threat in its functioning. Petitioner has filed various representations before the Police by virtue of Exts.P3 and P4. However, no action has been taken so far.
texts.arguments: 3. Heard Sri.A.Rajasimhan the learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri.P.P.Thajudeen, the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondents 1 and 2 and Sri.Rajit,the learned counsel for the additional third respondent. 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner Sri.A.Rajasimhan submits that the inaction on the part of the concerned police officials is unjustifiable and illegal. The learned counsel further submits that the Police are bound to give police protection but they are asking the petitioner not to open the hotel. According to the learned counsel, there exists a very serious situation which has resulted in the violation of the petitioner's fundamental rights guaranteed under Articles 19(1)(g) and 21 of the Faisal V.B vs District Police Chief on 29 March, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185554435/ 2 Constitution of India. WP(C) NO.4634 OF 2019 :-4-: 5. Per contra, the learned Senior Government Pleader submits that on 2.1.2019, the Sabarimala Karma Samithi activists demanded to close down the said hotel in protest in connection with the recent issues at Sabarimala. According to the learned Senior Government Pleader, the petitioner, who is one of the partners of the said hotel, objected the demand of the activists, informing that they had already prepared the food for that day and closure of the said shoproom would lead to economic loss for them. It is further submitted that on 3.1.2019, the very same activists declared statewide harthal on the Sabarimala women entry issue and several SDPI workers from different parts of the District, including the petitioner, assembled in front of the hotel with deadly weapons and attacked the BJP workers. Recording the statement of the victim, Police registered crime No.8/2019 under Section 143,147,148,153,341,324,307 r/w 149 IPC against the assailants. According to the learned Senior Government Pleader, the act of the assailants had depicted that they were radical outfits with communal colour, which had created panic situation among general public. WP(C) NO.4634 OF 2019 :-5-: 6. In the statement filed by the Station House Officer dated 25.2.2019 before this Court, it is clearly stated that the Police has ensured protection and surveillance to the petitioner's hotel on 3.1.2019. It is also stated that after the incident, the Police had ensured law and order by providing police picket at the premises of the hotel consisting of 6 Police Personnel including 4 Armed Police Personnel and two local men with Control Room Vehicle and the same is ensured round the clock. 7. Last but not the least, the learned Senior Government Pleader submits that there is an apprehension for causing communal conflicts between the religious groups with regard to the functioning of this hotel, which is located near to the Ganeshamangalam Temple where Hindu festivals are conducted. Learned Senior Government Pleader further submits that the petitioner constructed huts attached to the hotel in violation to the Panchayat Act and rules.
